title: Claude Code AEC Templates
description:
AEC work runs on repetitive paperwork and code lookups — RFIs, transmittals, meeting minutes, payment applications, egress and allowable-area checks. Claude Code AEC Templates is a catalog of ready-made Claude Code tools — skills, slash commands, agents, and workflows — that do this work in plain language, right inside your editor. 70+ tools today, built specifically for North American architects, engineers, and builders.

The catalog covers the day-to-day: drafting construction-administration documents (RFIs, ASIs, CCDs, transmittals, meeting minutes, payment applications), running code checks against IBC / ADA / ASCE (egress, occupant load, allowable area, FAR, fire ratings), and explaining the dense stuff (zoning, specs, AIA contracts, load paths, stamps). Every tool follows North American conventions — Imperial units, IBC/AIA/ASHRAE codes, and real jurisdictions like NYC DOB and CA HCAI.
Anyone can install a tool with a single command — it drops straight into your ~/.claude folder and is ready after a restart. The whole library is editable from a Notion-backed site that publishes each tool's page and install command automatically, so the catalog keeps growing without manual packaging.
